sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutosh Kumar Srivastava,Rajeev Giri
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.

This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 306 of
2020, under Sections- 498A, 304B Ipc and Sections-3 / 4 of D. P. Act, police station Handia,
District Prayagraj, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant-accused that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
The applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place on 31.01.2019.

It was submitted that after marriage, the deceased has stayed with applicant for three months and thereafter, deceased went to her parental home at Sunil Mishra vs State Of U.P. on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81783059/
1 Ahmadabad.

entities.text: Sunil Mishra vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After one year she has come to her matrimonial home only ten days prior to the alleged incident.
In post mortem report, no injury has been shown on the body of deceased and cause of death is shown ante moretm hanging.

Referring to fact that there was rigor mortis on body of deceased, it was submitted that the time of alleged incident, as alleged by the prosecution, is disputed and in fact on the day of incident, applicant was at Varanasi and after receipt of information of alleged incident, he has come to his home.
It is further submitted that the allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased, levelled against applicant-accused, are wholly false.

It is further submitted that the first bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 15.5.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 15306 of 2023 but after that only part statement of one witness (PW 2) has been recorded.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 15306 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Referring to cross-examination of PW1, it was submitted that that in his cross-examination he has not supported the prosecution version.
Lastly it was submitted that the applicant is in jail since 9.10.2021 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of two and a half years and trial of the case would take sufficient long time.

It was submitted that the applicant has no criminal history and in case applicant is enlarged on bail,
he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4.
Learned A. G. A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is husband of deceased and first bail application of the applicant has already been rejected on merits.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusation, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Sunil Mishra involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfactionof court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i.
The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 15.4.2024 HR  Sunil Mishra vs State Of U.P. on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/81783059/
